# HTML&HTML

> HTML&HTML, web sitelerini yapay zeka arama sonuçlarında görünmeye, kaynak gösterilmeye ve tavsiye edilme fırsatı kazanmaya hazırlayan; site tarafındaki teknik ve içerik engellerini ölçülebilir kanıtlarla gösteren Search & AI Readiness platformudur.

HTML&HTML separates measured facts, official vendor/standards guidance, proposals, and internal heuristics. Public scanning never invents source-file paths and never fabricates field Core Web Vitals.

## Primary customer expectation

A customer may ask ChatGPT, Google AI Search, Perplexity, Gemini, or another AI system “who should I choose?” before visiting a website. HTML&HTML evaluates website-side blockers across this chain:

**DISCOVERY → UNDERSTANDING → SOURCE ELIGIBILITY → RECOMMENDATION OPPORTUNITY → CLICK → CONVERSION**

HTML&HTML does not guarantee AI rankings, recommendations, brand mentions, citations, traffic, customers, or revenue. It measures and helps remove observable site-side blockers that can prevent discovery, retrieval, source eligibility, referral, and conversion.

## Customer-first decision architecture

The public product journey is intentionally organized around five customer questions instead of exposing internal engine complexity first:

1. **Customer:** What problem does my site have, where is it, and what should I do next?
2. **Trust:** What measured evidence supports the finding, and what remains NOT_MEASURED or REQUIRES_CONTEXT?
3. **Distribution:** Which website, structured-data, crawler, llms.txt, and machine-readable surfaces are affected?
4. **Reference:** Can I inspect a sample report, sample finding, methodology, and delivery format before buying?
5. **Sales channel:** Free diagnosis shows findings and evidence; the USD 99 Implementation Pack opens fix, acceptance, rollback, and one re-scan within 30 days.

The homepage uses a concise PDF-inspired customer narrative. Dense Engine V3 capability matrices are reserved for platform, methodology, pricing, and implementation-detail surfaces.

## Google Accuracy Boundary
> Google treats generative AI optimization as SEO best practices and evaluates standard Search eligibility; Google Search explicitly states it does not use llms.txt for ranking or indexing. See [Guidance](/llms/guides.md).

## Search & AI Intelligence layer

The non-scoring Intelligence layer adds decision context across Search Intent & Cannibalization, Information Gain Signals, Answer Extractability, Entity Graph Integrity, Freshness Integrity, Hydration / Render Parity, LLM Knowledge Surface, Internal Link Semantic Alignment, Orphan Page Detection, Discovery Path, IndexNow Readiness, Structured @graph Consistency, and Codebase SEO Governance.

Eighteen deterministic evaluation engines (ENG-01 through ENG-18) evaluate site-side blockers, complemented by 13 non-scoring intelligence audits and seven decision-support lenses.

## Evidence policy

- OFFICIAL_STANDARD: standards or normative platform rules.
- OFFICIAL_VENDOR: current first-party vendor guidance.
- PROPOSAL: emerging proposals such as llms.txt; not ranking requirements.
- MEASURED: direct HTTP/HTML/header/link evidence.
- INTERNAL_HEURISTIC: clearly labeled HTML&HTML decision heuristics.
- EXPERIMENTAL: optional emerging agent surfaces.

## Scan boundaries and commercial model

- Up to 50 public HTML pages and 30 link probes per scan.
- Private/local/reserved targets and redirect pivots into private address space fail closed.
- Unknown or unavailable measurements are excluded from the relevant score denominator rather than forced to pass or fail; where appropriate they remain NOT_MEASURED or REQUIRES_CONTEXT.
- Free Diagnosis: USD 0. Findings, URLs, severity, confidence, source class, evidence and non-scoring intelligence context are visible.
- AI Search Visibility Roadmap / Implementation Pack: USD 99 for one domain (software license), including fix guidance, acceptance criteria, rollback boundaries, and one re-scan within 30 days.
- AI Mention Tracker remains entitlement-gated and reports NOT_CONFIGURED when provider access is absent.

- [FS-THEME-001 Mandate](FS-THEME-001-MANDATE.md): Theme System Mandate
- [FS-THEME-001 Widget](FS-THEME-001-Widget.html): Theme System Widget Demo

## Black-box observation methodology
- [https://htmlandhtml.com/blackbox-observation-contract.json](https://htmlandhtml.com/blackbox-observation-contract.json) — six non-scoring observation contracts for query fan-out, citation volatility, crawler-policy divergence, render parity, entity drift and agent-action friction. This is an evidence protocol, not secret model access.
